cases.name: markNeedsUpdate is ignored during scriptUpdate
cases.note: The literal Lua generator and Context.markNeedsUpdate callback attach to a concrete production ScriptedDrawable occurrence, directly assert its authoritative inUpdatePhase field is false immediately before and after the live update, and assert live update-phase suppression plus restored outside-phase dirt.

adaptation.rationale: Rust has no public abstract ScriptedDrawable constructor or direct scriptUpdate call; the test uses a pinned concrete ScriptedDrawable occurrence and schedules the same callback through ArtboardInstance's production update owner.
adaptation.inapplicable_observable: The C++ test subclass's dirt counter and direct protected scriptUpdate entry are unavailable; Rust preserves both authoritative phase assertions and asserts the live ScriptUpdate component bit before, during, and after the scheduled callback.

cases.name: inUpdatePhase defaults to false
cases.note: A distinct test constructs the concrete production ScriptedDrawable occurrence and directly asserts its authoritative per-owner phase bit defaults false.

cases.name: markNeedsUpdate works outside update phase
cases.note: A concrete production ScriptedDrawable owner receives both exact outside-phase requests and publishes live ScriptUpdate dirt.

adaptation.rationale: The C++ test subclass overrides addScriptedDirt solely to count calls; Rust's production owner uses an idempotent ComponentDirt bit and returns whether each request reached the owner.
adaptation.inapplicable_observable: The artificial subclass dirt-call count 0/1/2 is not a production observable in Rust; the test asserts the exact empty/set dirt states and that both live owner calls succeed.
